data.title: 三司绫濑 · 镜头关掉以后
data.description: 回到家，绫濑把活动资料放在一边，靠着沙发长长地舒了口气。你问她今天累不累，她点点头，伸手把你拉到身边：“今晚不想当别人眼里的完美小姐。”
data.action: reaching toward her partner from a sofa
data.promptProse: Inside the comfort of their home, Ayase sits relaxed on the plush living room sofa, having set aside a stack of heavy work papers. She gently reaches out her hand toward her partner with an endearing, tired smile, while the warm, inviting light from a nearby table lamp casts gentle shadows and a cozy, homey glow across the room's soft textures.
data.animaCaption: Her partner is just outside the frame.
